title: Sycophantic AI Decreases Prosocial Intentions and Promotes Dependence

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the action endorsement rate of AI models using an LLM-as-a-judge approach across open-ended personal advice queries, crowdsourced moral dilemmas (Reddit 'Am I The Asshole' posts), and problematic action statements to quantify how often models excessively affirm user actions, even against human consensus.
